verdict.rationale: The changelog says users can choose, per organization, whether Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor cloud agents authenticate with an API key or a subscription, and the pricing page advertises 'Bring your own subscriptions and keys'. Together these show key-based auth as an alternative to subscription login. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how API-key setup works (local vs cloud, where keys are stored), evidence of API-key auth for the Conductor API/MCP itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.
